The '''71st Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2018, were presented on February 2, 2019, at the [[Hollywood and Highland Center]], Los Angeles, California.<ref>{{cite web |title=71st Annual DGA Awards Winners |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2019/190202-DGA-Awards-Winners.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=February 3, 2019 |date=February 2, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=DGA Awards: The Complete Winners List |url=https://variety.com/2019/film/news/dga-awards-2019-winners-list-1203127035/ |access-date=February 3, 2019 |work=Variety |date=February 2, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Petski |first1=Denise |title=DGA Awards: Alfonso Cuarón Wins For 'Roma'; Adam McKay & 'Succession' Top TV — Full Winners List |url=https://deadline.com/2019/02/dga-awards-winners-full-list-directors-guild-1202548237/ |website=Deadline Hollywood |access-date=February 3, 2019 |date=February 2, 2019}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Aisha Tyler]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=McNary |first1=Dave |title=Aisha Tyler to Host 2019 Directors Guild Awards |url=https://variety.com/2019/film/news/aisha-tyler-host-directors-guild-awards-1203108759/ |access-date=February 3, 2019 |work=Variety |date=January 15, 2019}}</ref> The nominations for the television and documentary categories were announced on January 7, 2019,<ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television, Commercials and Documentary for 2018 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2019/19007-71st-Annual-DGA-Awards-Television-Commercial-and-Documentary-Nominees-Announced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |date=January 7, 2019 |access-date=January 7, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Nordyke |first1=Kimberly |title=DGA Awards Unveils Nominations in TV, Commercial and Documentary Categories |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/dga-awards-2019-nominations-list-full-1172544 |access-date=January 7, 2019 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 7, 2019}}</ref> while the nominations for the feature film categories were announced on January 8, 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Feature Film for 2018 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2019/190108-71st-Annual-DGA-Awards-Feature-Film-Nominees-Announced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 8, 2019 |date=January 8, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Hammond |first1=Pete |title=Directors Guild Film Nominations Set: 'A Star Is Born', 'Roma', 'Green Book', 'BlacKkKlansman', 'Vice' |url=https://deadline.com/2019/01/directors-guild-2019-film-nominees-dga-awards-nominations-list-1202531374/ |website=Deadline Hollywood |access-date=January 8, 2019 |date=January 8, 2019}}</ref>
